sections.10-1-why-this-chapter-comes-first: Dil aur phephron ki physio mein sab se ahem sawaal yeh hai ke kya patient exercise ke liye mehfooz hai. Yeh chapter is ka tareeqa sikhata hai.
sections.10-2-chart-review-before-you-see-the-pat: Patient ko dekhne se pehle chart parhein: diagnosis, oxygen, vital signs ka rujhan, lab results aur doctor ki pabandiyan.
sections.10-3-normal-adult-values-resting-typical: Normal adult values: dhadkan 60-100, saans 12-20, SpO2 aam taur par 94-98%, aur BP. In se muqabla kar ke faisla karein.
sections.10-4-subjective-assessment: Saans phoolna kab aur kitna, khansi aur balgham, seene ka dard aur roz ke kaam ki salahiyat poochein.
sections.10-5-objective-assessment: Dekhna (posture, gardan ki muscles se saans), seene ki aawaz, seene ka phailao, sujan aur vital signs.
sections.10-6-exercise-testing: 6-minute walk test 30 metre ki seedhi raahdari mein: faasla, SpO2, dhadkan aur saans ki takleef note karein.
sections.10-7-when-not-to-start-and-when-to-stop-: Kab exercise shuru na karein aur kab rokein: aaraam mein seene ka dard, SpO2 ka bohat girna, BP ya dhadkan ka ghair-mehfooz hona.
sections.10-8-questions-with-answers: Sawaal hal karein, khaas kar blood gas parhne ki practice.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
